Interface FileOutput

All Known Implementing Classes:
ImageOutput, NetpbmOutput, NetpbmOutputStream, NetpbmWriter
public interface FileOutput
Contract for writing a structured file

Writing is split into two phases that must be called in order on the same open FileOutputStream:

  1. writeHeader(FileOutputStream) – serialises and writes the plain-text header (magic word, dimensions, max value) in US-ASCII.
  2. writeBody(FileOutputStream) – writes the pixel data immediately after the header

Dmitro Dashchenko
